### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **skill:** /dso:implementation-plan
* **story:** 176e-905b (As an engineer, I can invoke /dso:respond-to-pr-comments)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When /dso:implementation-plan generates tasks for a story whose only deliverable is a SKILL.md file (an LLM prose document), it must either:
(a) skip the RED test task entirely (no testable behavioral code exists), or
(b) propose only behavioral integration tests that invoke code and assert on observable outputs.
Per the Behavioral Testing Standard: grepping a source file for content existence is explicitly prohibited as a change-detector test. The behavioral testing standard is at plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md.

#### Actual Behavior

/dso:implementation-plan created task 57db-d815-16cd-4f59: "Write RED tests for respond-to-pr-comments SKILL.md existence and required content". The task's test plan was:
1. Check file exists at expected path (grep/test -f)
2. Check SKILL.md contains 'name: respond-to-pr-comments' (grep)
3. Check SKILL.md contains 'No unresolved comments found on PR #' (grep)
4. Check SKILL.md contains accept/defend/defer keywords (grep)
5. Check SKILL.md contains summary table columns (grep)
6. Check SKILL.md contains 'github.com' (grep)

All 6 proposed tests are change-detector tests (grep source file content → existence checks). None invoke code or assert on observable behavior. This violates the prohibition on change-detector tests in the behavioral testing standard.

The plan review (Step 4) did not catch this — the TDD dimension scored 5/5 despite the change-detector pattern.

### 3. Action History

* Invoked /dso:implementation-plan 176e-905b from /dso:sprint orchestrator
* Plan review completed — TDD dimension scored 5/5
* Task 57db-d815-16cd-4f59 created with change-detector test plan
* Sub-agent dispatched to implement the tasks
* User flagged the violation; task was abandoned and bug filed

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* /dso:implementation-plan Step 3 (Atomic Task Drafting): Unit Test Exemption Criteria section says to omit RED test when "Any test would be a change-detector test — only asserts the code exists, not that it behaves correctly." This exemption was not applied.
* /dso:implementation-plan Step 4 (Plan Review): TDD reviewer at plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/docs/reviewers/plan/tdd.md should catch change-detector patterns in RED test tasks.
data.title: [implementation-plan]: SKILL.md stories generate change-detector test tasks -> test tasks violate behavioral testing standard
